title: Teen Crashes During Police Chase, Gets Busted With Hallucinogenic Drugs
description:
On February 6, 2022, a 17-year-old driver nearly struck a marked squad car in Stevens Point, WI. The officer attempted to conduct multiple traffic stops on the vehicle but the suspect continued to flee. Eventually, they were able to pit the suspect’s vehicle causing him to spin out and surrender to police.

For business inquiries or issues regarding an incident contact:
codebluecam@gmail.com

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
